units.source_text: 这是很肤浅的见解，不会得罪任何一方。

en.t: This is a very superficial opinion, and it will not offend either side.

units.source_text: 看来，他不会说出我希望的那种评语。

en.t: It seems he will not offer the kind of comment I was hoping for.

units.source_text: 他若应我的提问，判断细棋的形势，也许倒是一种大胆的回答。

en.t: If he answered my question by judging the position in the close game, that might actually be a rather bold reply.
